title: 軌道車輛空氣彈簧
summary: 從載重變化到氣室和高度調整，用明確的絕對壓力與有效體積分析。
summaryEn: Follow load changes through chambers and leveling using explicit absolute pressure and effective volume.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 空氣彈簧剛度尺度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Air-spring stiffness scale: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 空氣彈簧剛度尺度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Air-spring stiffness scale and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為空氣彈簧、附加氣室與高度閥。固定有效面積的多方氣體模型估算小振幅剛度；橡膠形狀和附加氣室另有影響。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows air spring, auxiliary chamber and leveling valve. A fixed-area polytropic gas model estimates small-signal stiffness; rubber geometry and auxiliary chambers add effects.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：k=n pabs A²/V；n=1.4、pabs=600000 Pa、A=.08 m²、V=.03 m³；計算結果=179200 N/m。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: k=n pabs A²/V; n=1.4, pabs=600000 Pa, A=.08 m², V=.03 m³; result=179200 N/m.
steps.failure: 把表壓用於氣體剛度會低估；先轉絕對壓力再分析。
steps.failureEn: Using gauge pressure underestimates gas stiffness; convert to absolute pressure first.
steps.check: 基準179200 N/m；體積加倍時此模型剛度減半。 將此判讀連回空氣彈簧、附加氣室與高度閥的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: Baseline is 179200 N/m; doubling volume halves stiffness in this model. Relate this interpretation to air spring, auxiliary chamber and leveling valve and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.
